- Normalize by iterating each character: for each letter, determine if it’s a vowel (aeiouAEIOU) before case swap; map vowels to the letter 2 positions ahead in the alphabet preserving original case before swap (e.g., a/A→c/C, e/E→g/G, i/I→k/K, o/O→q/Q, u/U→w/W).
- After vowel substitution (based on original character), swap the case of the resulting character (lower→upper, upper→lower); consonants undergo only case swap.
- Construct the output by joining transformed characters; assume spaces and non-letters are not present per spec (only letters), but if present, decide to keep them unchanged then case-swap accordingly to match examples showing spaces preserved.
